create_text_translator: create a TextTranslator to translate source text to a target language using a Seq2SeqGenerator
batch_translate_texts: batch translate a list of source texts using TextTranslator and get translated outputs
create_text_completer: create a TextCompleter to complete text prompts using a SequenceGenerator and tokenizer
batch_complete_prompts: batch complete a list of text prompts using TextCompleter and get completed outputs
convert_sequence_to_text: convert a source sequence tensor to text using SequenceToTextConverter with a generator
